channel.description: Recent content in Shell on DAWN's Blog

item.title: Shell Scripting Hands-on (Part 1): Script Specifications, Variable Classification, and String Slicing/Substitution
item.description: A systematic review of enterprise-grade Shell script development and execution standards. Deep dive into global environment variables, local variables, and special positional parameters ($0-$9, $#, $*, $@, $?). Master advanced native Bash string parameter expansion techniques including slicing, length evaluation, greedy pattern truncation, and substitution.

item.title: Linux awk Text Analysis Tool: From Syntax Principles to Nginx Access Log Statistics
item.description: A systematic analysis of awk, one of the three core Linux text processing tools. Covers its working mechanism and lifecycle (BEGIN/BODY/END), core internal variables and printf formatting, pattern matching, conditional/loop control, and 11 real-world enterprise Nginx log analysis scenarios utilizing associative arrays.

item.title: Linux sed Stream Editor Hands-on: Pattern Space and Hold Space
item.description: An in-depth analysis of the core architecture of sed (Stream Editor), systematically reviewing common options and editing actions, deeply dissecting the interaction mechanism between Pattern Space and Hold Space, and demonstrating multi-editing, inverted selection, and batch configuration cleanup based on enterprise practical cases.

item.title: Linux Hands-on Basics: Regular Expressions (BRE/ERE) and grep Text Filtering
item.description: A systematic review of Basic Regular Expressions (BRE) and Extended Regular Expressions (ERE) in Linux operations, deeply analyzing grep text filtering commands based on the dawn host across 14 core practical cases.
